name: Beta-Hydroxy Beta-Methylbutyrate (HMB)
mechanism: Leucine metabolite; anti-catabolic via ubiquitin-proteasome inhibition; activates mTOR
notes: Directly suppresses FBXO32 (atrogin-1) and TRIM63 (MuRF1) - key atrophy ubiquitin ligases

name: Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone)
mechanism: Mitochondrial electron transport; antioxidant; ATP production
notes: Our signature shows upregulation of mitochondrial ETC genes - CoQ10 may support mitochondrial function

name: Creatine Monohydrate
mechanism: Phosphocreatine reservoir; ATP buffering; increases muscle mass and strength; satellite cell activation

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
mechanism: Muscle function; satellite cell activation; protein synthesis; anti-inflammatory
notes: NASA has studied vitamin D in astronauts - deficiency common in spaceflight

name: Resveratrol
mechanism: SIRT1 activator; AMPK modulation; anti-inflammatory; mitochondrial biogenesis via PGC-1a

name: Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG)
mechanism: Green tea catechin; anti-inflammatory; FOXO3 modulation; anti-apoptotic in muscle

name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
mechanism: Antioxidant; collagen synthesis; carnitine biosynthesis; iron absorption

name: Leucine
mechanism: mTORC1 activator via Sestrin2 binding; stimulates MPS; most potent BCAA for muscle protein synthesis
notes: Key leucine threshold ~2-3g per meal for MPS stimulation

name: L-Citrulline
mechanism: More efficient NO precursor than arginine; protein synthesis; muscle fatigue reduction

name: Glycine
mechanism: Collagen synthesis; glutathione precursor; anti-inflammatory; sleep quality

name: Nicotinamide Riboside (NR)
mechanism: NAD+ precursor; SIRT1/3 activation; mitochondrial biogenesis; energy metabolism
notes: PGC-1a is down-regulated in our signature; NR may restore mitochondrial biogenesis

name: L-Arginine
mechanism: NO precursor; vasodilation; growth hormone stimulation; mTOR activation

name: Spermidine
mechanism: Autophagy induction; anti-aging; cardioprotective; mTOR modulation

name: Quercetin
mechanism: Anti-inflammatory; mitochondrial biogenesis; AMPK activation; anti-oxidant

name: Curcumin
mechanism: Anti-inflammatory via NF-kB inhibition; antioxidant; anti-catabolic via TNF-a suppression

name: Omega-3 EPA
mechanism: Anti-inflammatory; muscle protein synthesis sensitization; mTOR activation
notes: Sensitizes muscle to leucine-stimulated MPS; NASA nutrition research interest

name: Omega-3 DHA
mechanism: Anti-inflammatory; membrane fluidity; muscle protein synthesis; neuroprotective

name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
mechanism: Antioxidant; AMPK activation; insulin sensitizer; mitochondrial function

name: Genistein
mechanism: Phytoestrogen; anti-inflammatory; mTOR modulation; antioxidant

name: L-Glutamine
mechanism: Conditionally essential; protein synthesis; glutathione precursor; immune support

name: Isoleucine
mechanism: BCAA; contributes to MPS; glucose uptake enhancement

name: Magnesium
mechanism: Muscle relaxation; ATP metabolism; protein synthesis cofactor; neuromuscular function

name: Valine
mechanism: BCAA; contributes to MPS; less potent than leucine for mTOR

name: Zinc
mechanism: Antioxidant (SOD cofactor); protein synthesis; testosterone; wound healing

name: Taurine
mechanism: Osmoregulation; calcium signaling; antioxidant; muscle function; anti-fatigue

name: Melatonin
mechanism: Antioxidant; anti-inflammatory; mitochondrial protection; sleep regulation
notes: Sleep disruption in spaceflight; melatonin may address circadian + antioxidant needs

name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
mechanism: Antioxidant; membrane protection; anti-inflammatory in muscle

name: N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC)
mechanism: Glutathione precursor; antioxidant; anti-inflammatory; redox balance

name: Astaxanthin
mechanism: Potent antioxidant; anti-inflammatory; mitochondrial protection; exercise recovery

name: Beta-Alanine
mechanism: Carnosine precursor; pH buffering; anti-fatigue; muscle endurance

name: Piperine
mechanism: Bioavailability enhancer; inhibits glucuronidation; increases absorption of curcumin and other compounds
